decisions.reason: After several years with no visible follow-through and weak strategic fit to the firm's industrial waste-to-energy focus, the learning value of this low-cost consumer option now looks exhausted and resources are better redeployed.

These modular plant extensions still fit the core engineering business, can be folded into bespoke projects across models, and remain a worthwhile option to hold in a growing market despite limited recent visibility.

As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy offering with strong strategic fit and capability spillovers, it remains sensible to retain while market realization for such industrial plants can take longer than for simpler products.
